guest: I love fragrant Thai curries, but I have a severe peanut allergy. Tom doesn't have any food restrictions.
reply: Thank you for telling me about the severe peanut allergy; any dinner arrangements would need the kitchen’s confirmation of ingredients and cross-contact precautions. For your anniversary, would a small private note be a welcome touch, or would you rather keep the occasion just between yourselves?
